item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 14/Apr/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The easterly airstream affecting the coast of Guangdong will moderate today. A northerly airstream will bring showers to southern China today and tomorrow. The associated relatively dry continental airstream will bring mainly fine weather to the region over the weekend. Under the influence of a southerly airstream, there will be a few showers over the coast of Guangdong early next week. A trough of low pressure will bring unsettled weather to southern China in the middle and latter parts of next week.
